system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: the engine dynamically narrows the context on each turn to only what's immediately relevant

env_context_strategy.note: Retrievers + glossary + embedders inject domain knowledge; not a code repo harness.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Information regarding their intent needs to be captured from not only their last N messages, but from the conversation as a whole.
context_compaction.note: No compaction mechanism described in available evidence.

observation_format.evidence_quote: they always use LLMs to generate JSON schemas that in turn are converted to Pydantic models

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: All LLM requests in Parlant are actually made using these schematic generators, which means that, whatever model you use, it must be able to generate valid JSON schemas consistently.
tool_call_format.note: Tool calling is decided by a Tool Caller component producing structured JSON, not provider tool APIs.

tool_count.note: Tools are user-defined; no fixed default tool set stated.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: External APIs and workflows, triggered only when their observation matches.
edit_primitive.note: Conversational harness; no file-editing tool registered.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote:
@p.tool
async def query_docs(context: p.ToolContext, user_query: str) -> p.ToolResult:
tool_schema_source.note: Schemas derived from Python function signatures via the @p.tool decorator.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Any external workflow or agent becomes a Parlant tool, triggered only when relevant
protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A client visible in the supplied file tree.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: B["Match Guidelines and Resolve Journey States"]:::matchNode
loop_primitives.note: Match -> tool call -> message generation pipeline; sessions are event-driven.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Multi-turn SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures). Define a flow for processes like booking, troubleshooting, or onboarding.
planning_granularity.note: Journeys with states/transitions are stored and resolved each turn.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Any external workflow or agent becomes a Parlant tool, triggered only when relevant
delegation_mechanism.note: External agents enter only as tools, not as spawned Parlant agents.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Sometimes it makes sense for a human (perhaps a developer) to manually add messages on behalf of the AI agent.

short_term_state.note: Session events plus journey state and variables.

long_term_memory.note: Embedders/vector DBs (chroma, qdrant, mongo) persist across sessions; variables act as memories.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Add message to session and trigger the agent
state_persistence.note: Sessions persisted in a SessionStore (json_file/mongo) and continued at any time.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the agent selects the template that best matches its generated draft instead of sending it directly
self_verification.note: Canned-response matching is an output constraint rather than a verification of work.

rollback.evidence_quote: Instead of sending a large system prompt followed by a raw conversation to the model, Parlant first assembles a focused context

termination_condition.note: A turn ends when the message is generated/sent.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: using smaller models is actually a great way to reduce costs, latency—and sometimes even accuracy—in production environments.
cost_controls.note: Per-schema generators allow different models per task; token estimation used for cost/rate management.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Parlant implements this functionality with a long-polling, timeout-restricted API endpoint for listing new events.

execution_isolation.note: Tools are in-process Python async functions; no sandbox.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: The same pattern works with LlamaIndex query engines, Agno agents, or any async Python function.
filesystem_access.note: Relative to the host process boundary.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Tools activate only when their observation matches; they don't sit in the context permanently.
permission_model.note: Guideline/observation matching gates which tools may be invoked.

tracing.evidence_quote: Full OpenTelemetry tracing — every guideline match and decision is logged.

replayability.evidence_quote: it returns a *status event* containing the same *Trace ID* as the eventual agent's message event
replayability.note: Sessions/events are persisted and inspectable; no replay runner cited.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Parlant handles conversational governance; it doesn't replace your existing stack.
eval_hooks.note: No benchmark evaluation runner in the supplied file tree.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Parlant includes a comprehensive content moderation system to filter harmful or inappropriate user input.
guardrails.note: Moderation filters input; canned responses constrain output; guideline matching gates tool actions.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Build reliable customer-facing AI agents with Parlant: an interaction control harness optimized for controlled, consistent, and predictable LLM interactions.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Parlant works with most LLM providers.
